request.objective: Start at https://www.qatarairways.com/. Find the weight of baggage allowance for economy class on Qatar Airways.

response.result:
On Qatar Airways' baggage allowance page (qatarairways.com → Baggage → Baggage allowance), economy has no single weight — it depends on the fare family and the route:

**Checked baggage — flights to/from Africa or the Americas (piece concept)**
- Economy Lite: 1 piece up to **23 kg (50 lb)**
- Economy Classic / Convenience / Comfort: 2 pieces, each up to **23 kg (50 lb)**

**Checked baggage — all other destinations (weight concept)**
- Economy Lite: **20 kg (44 lb)**
- Economy Classic: **25 kg (55 lb)**
- Economy Convenience: **30 kg (66 lb)**
- Economy Comfort: **35 kg (77 lb)**

**Carry-on baggage (all economy fares)**
- 1 piece up to **7 kg (15 lb)**

Short answer: **23 kg per bag** on Americas/Africa routes, or **20–35 kg in total depending on fare family** on all other routes, plus **7 kg** of cabin baggage.
